subject: Finance ops: Q2 renewal gate — commit & stage hygiene request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Finance ops: Q2 renewal gate — commit & stage hygiene request

Team —

Quick ask from Finance/Rev Ops as we lock Q2 forecasting: we need all renewal opportunities with renewal dates in May–June to have updated stage + a committed ARR number in the commit sheet by EOD Friday (4/23). Goals: clean commit line for the forecast and a separate churn-watchlist for at-risk accounts.

Please do the following for any account you own or are covering:
- Confirm renewal date and set stage to one of: commit / negotiation / at-risk.
- Populate committed ARR in the Q2_renewal_commit_sheet.xlsx (Drive link below). If numbers are pending, mark the field "Pending — customer sign" and include the expected sign date.
- If you set stage to at-risk, add a 1–2 line reason and mitigation plan in the notes column.
- Upload any latest signed docs or procurement notes to the Drive link and flag in the sheet.

Why: finance needs a high-confidence commit line for the revenue plan. Ops will run a scrub on Monday and escalate accounts marked at-risk >$50k ARR.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cACMErenewal
Attachment: Q2_renewal_commit_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finance ops: Q2 renewal gate — commit & stage hygiene request

Thanks Naomi — noted. I'll do a pass on our top 25 by ARR and update the sheet tonight. A few quick calls already scheduled with customers that look like negotiation-stage. I'll mark any with legal/procurement blocking items as at-risk and include short mitigation.

Preliminary notes for Acme Corp (I'll update in the sheet):
- Current ARR: $125,000
- Renewal window: 5/14/2027
- Status: negotiation (pricing variance requested)
- Ask: procurement asked for a 12-month PO and a SOC 2 attestation copy; are we able to provide current SOC 2 report to them this week?

I'll add the docs and flag if I need help escalating.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finance ops: Q2 renewal gate — commit & stage hygiene request

Adding a couple of operational points from Sales ops:
- I'll run the commit sheet through our pipeline hygiene script on Monday morning and produce a delta report. That'll highlight accounts moved to at-risk and any missing ARR values.
- For accounts with procurement asks (Acme included), please add the DocuSign or draft SOW link in the "Docs" column. If procurement requires SOC 2, point them to the public compliance page: https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2 or send the signed SOC2 via the secure share — let me know and I'll coordinate with Security.

Also: can Sales leaders confirm which reps are primary owners for the accounts we're treating as committed? This avoids double-counting in the commit line.

Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Sarah Blessing <sarah.blessing@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finance ops: Q2 renewal gate — commit & stage hygiene request

Hi Marissa / Naomi —

Thanks for the heads up. A couple quick items from our side:
- We've completed internal approval; procurement needs a renewed SOW and the most recent SOC 2 report to issue the PO.
- We're targeting signature by 5/10/2027 but the PO will be issued once procurement receives SOC 2 and the SOW showing 12-month term.

I'm attaching the internal checklist. Please send the SOC 2 PDF and an updated SOW (ACME_Renewal_Draft_v3.pdf) and we'll route it through procurement.

Attachment: ACME_internal_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Sarah Blessing
Finance Manager — Acme Corp
sarah.blessing@acme.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Perfect — thanks Sarah. Marissa: can you confirm you uploaded ACME_Renewal_Draft_v3.pdf and the SOC2 link to the Drive by EOD today so procurement has time to review? I'll mark Acme as "commit—pending PO" in the sheet once docs are uploaded and note expected PO date 2027-05-10.

Evelyn: FYI — flag Acme on the churn-watchlist if documentation timelines slip past 5/3; >$50k threshold applies.

I'll run a quick scrub Monday morning and send the delta to Finance.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
